dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: A single, thin, high-contrast white band is clearly visible across the greater coverts against a dark wing body.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, pale bluish-grey linear boundaries are highly prominent along the edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, high-contrast white rectangular patch visible on the posterior nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear transition separates the black crown from the lighter yellowish mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white cheek patch and a dark ventral stripe are prominent features.
